question: What is the meaning of mean time between failures in relation to product durability and reliability?
description:
The mean time between failures (MTBF) is a measure of the reliability of a product. It represents the average time between failures during normal product operation. MTBF is used to predict the time at which a product is likely to fail, which is crucial for assessing product durability and reliability. A higher MTBF indicates a more reliable product with less frequent failures. <|ENDINPUT>
